text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a citizen of Vault 13.
source_text: You see a citizen of Vault 13.

text: 你看到一个13号避难所的公民。
source_text: 你看到一个13号避难所的公民。

text: We didn't think that you were coming back. You have# such a nice room, and we were a little crowded with# her parents. I hope you don't mind.
source_text:
We didn't think that you were coming back. You have
# such a nice room, and we were a little crowded with
# her parents. I hope you don't mind.

text: 我们没想到你回来了。你的房间挺漂亮，而我俩和她父母住在一起有点挤……我希望你不会介意。
source_text: 我们没想到你回来了。你的房间挺漂亮，而我俩和她父母住在一起有点挤……我希望你不会介意。

text: Yes, I do mind. Get out of my room!
source_text: Yes, I do mind. Get out of my room!

text: 不，我介意。滚出我的房间！
source_text: 不，我介意。滚出我的房间！

text: Nah, I don't care. Enjoy the room.
source_text: Nah, I don't care. Enjoy the room.

text: 啊，我不介意。祝你们住的愉快。
source_text: 啊，我不介意。祝你们住的愉快。

text: It would be reassuring to have my own quarters back.# Please find somewhere else to live.
source_text:
It would be reassuring to have my own quarters back.
# Please find somewhere else to live.

text: 把我的宿舍拿回来能让我感到安心。你们还是请另寻它处吧。
source_text: 把我的宿舍拿回来能让我感到安心。你们还是请另寻它处吧。

text: Hng.
source_text: Hng.

text: 哼。
source_text: 哼。

text: Look, I don't want to argue with you, but you# obviously don't deserve this room anymore. Please leave.
source_text:
Look, I don't want to argue with you, but you
# obviously don't deserve this room anymore. Please leave.

text: 你看，我不想跟你吵，但是显然这个房间已经不再属于你了。请离开。
source_text: 你看，我不想跟你吵，但是显然这个房间已经不再属于你了。请离开。

text: Look, we could really use the space. I hope you will reconsider.
source_text: Look, we could really use the space. I hope you will reconsider.

text: 你看，我们真的很需要这个房间。我希望你能重新考虑一下。
source_text: 你看，我们真的很需要这个房间。我希望你能重新考虑一下。

text: Well, let me think about it for a moment.# Hmmm. No. Get out!
source_text:
Well, let me think about it for a moment.
# Hmmm. No. Get out!

text: 让我想想。嗯。不行。滚出去！
source_text: 让我想想。嗯。不行。滚出去！

text: Well, ok. You need it more than I do.
source_text: Well, ok. You need it more than I do.

text: 哦，好吧。你们比我更需要它。
source_text: 哦，好吧。你们比我更需要它。

text: Thanks! We really appreciate it. We put your stuff in the trunk.
source_text: Thanks! We really appreciate it. We put your stuff in the trunk.

text: 谢谢！我们真的很感激。我们把你的东西放在这个箱子里。
source_text: 谢谢！我们真的很感激。我们把你的东西放在这个箱子里。

text: Well, I don't know. You don't seem to be using it very# often, and we sure could use the space.
source_text:
Well, I don't know. You don't seem to be using it very
# often, and we sure could use the space.

text: 呃，我不知道。你看起来不怎么常住，而我们确实要住这里。
source_text: 呃，我不知道。你看起来不怎么常住，而我们确实要住这里。

text: Fine. Take it.
source_text: Fine. Take it.

text: 好。待这吧。
source_text: 好。待这吧。

text: I need this place to remember my roots. And besides,# it's a good place to rest.
source_text:
I need this place to remember my roots. And besides,
# it's a good place to rest.

text: 我需要在这里怀念我的祖先。另外，这里是个休息的好地方。
source_text: 我需要在这里怀念我的祖先。另外，这里是个休息的好地方。

text: Gee, I didn't think you would still care about this place from what# I've heard. You have a good day. We'll go back to her mothers' place.
source_text:
Gee, I didn't think you would still care about this place from what
# I've heard. You have a good day. We'll go back to her mothers' place.

text: 天，我一直听说你不会再在乎这个地方了。那就告辞了，我们搬回到她母亲那里去。
source_text: 天，我一直听说你不会再在乎这个地方了。那就告辞了，我们搬回到她母亲那里去。

text: We really like it here.
source_text: We really like it here.

text: 我们真的很喜欢这里。
source_text: 我们真的很喜欢这里。

text: You should leave. This isn't your place here anymore.
source_text: You should leave. This isn't your place here anymore.

text: 你应该离开。这里已经不再是你的地方了。
source_text: 你应该离开。这里已经不再是你的地方了。
